jordan_cust: getting a 401 invalid_api_key when calling /v1/embeddings from our prod app, started ~5m ago

alex_support: thanks — can you paste the curl you used (scrubbed) and the response body?

jordan_cust: sure — minimal repro: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/embeddings \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJSU0...\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"text-embedding-3-small","input":"test"}'
```
response: `{"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"authentication failed"}`

maria_support: quick note — that Authorization looks like a JWT (starts with eyJ). Our hosted API expects a raw API key value (starts with rk_ or rw_ depending on key type). Can you confirm where that token came from?

jordan_cust: it's a token our infra team minted via our internal SSO service account flow (we call it sts.exchange). We assumed it could be presented directly to Redwood since it authenticates other services.

alex_support: aha. That's probably the issue — we don't accept arbitrary STS/JWTs as API keys. Hosted endpoints expect a Redwood API key or a properly exchanged token using our token-exchange endpoint. The failure shows as invalid_api_key (401) rather than a clearer aud/iss error.

jordan_cust: oh interesting. is there a recommended flow to use service accounts from CI without exposing long-lived keys?

maria_support: yes — two options:
1) Create a short-lived Redwood API key via our token-exchange endpoint (if your SSO can call it) — basically exchange your internal service token for a temporary rk_ token scoped to the call.
2) Create a scoped long-lived API key in the org dashboard and store it in your secrets manager (rotate regularly).

ryan_eng: adding detail from infra perspective: your STS JWT is valid in your identity system but it doesn't have the audience or signature our auth system recognizes. We intentionally separate identity tokens from API secrets for security. We can add a better error message but in the meantime the exchange endpoint is the right path.

alex_support: for quick repro — jordan, can you try generating an API key in the dashboard and hitting the same curl but with the raw key? Example header we expect: `-H \"Authorization: Bearer rk_abc123...\"`

jordan_cust: trying now... one sec

deploy-bot: deployment completed for service/my-app (rev 2026-03-18T12:30:02Z) :rocket:

jordan_cust: ok swapped to dashboard key, works ✅ response 200 and embeddings array returned. Thanks — that confirms it.

maria_support: great. I'll summarize steps and add links:
- Cause: presenting an internal STS/JWT to Redwood hosted API. Our auth layer does not accept arbitrary JWTs as API keys; tokens must be either Redwood API keys or obtained via our token-exchange flow.
- Short-term workaround: use a dashboard-created API key stored in your secrets manager.
- Recommended: implement token exchange for short-lived tokens (see docs: https://docs.redwood.inference/auth#token-exchange).
- Follow-up: we'll file a docs update request to make the 401 message clearer when a JWT/audience mismatch is detected.

alex_support: filing internal follow-up: ticket RED-4591 (docs + error-code improvement). tagging @ryan_eng for possible telemetry change so we surface a friendlier reason when aud mismatch detected.

ryan_eng: noted. I'll take a look at RED-4591. If Jordan wants, we can also whitelist a service-account integration path (enterprise only) so tokens from your SSO can be accepted after an org-level trust agreement.

jordan_cust: appreciate the help. can you add the exact curl we should use for the token-exchange path?

maria_support: sure — example exchange (replace values):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/token/exchange \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"subject_token":"eyJhbGciOi...","subject_token_type":"urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:jwt","scope":"embeddings.create"}'
```
response will include `access_token` (short-lived rk_ token). Use that in `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.

jordan_cust: perfect — we'll prototype that this afternoon. thanks all :pray:

alex_support: marking thread resolved for now. reopen if you hit problems with exchange flow. :thumbsup:
